identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Trial of YH25448(Lazertinib) as the First-line Treatment in Patients With EGFR Mutation Positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic NSCLC (LASER301)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-blind Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Lazertinib Versus Gefitinib as the First-line Treatment in Patients With Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Sensitizing Mutation Positive, Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

designInfo.interventionModelDescription:
Approximately 380 patients will be randomized in a 1:1 ratio to either lazertinib (n=190) or gefitinib (n= 190).

Following objective disease progression according to RECIST v1.1, as per investigator assessment, patients who were randomized to gefitinib arm may have the option to receive open-label lazertinib

armGroups.label: Lazertinib + Gefitinib-matching placebo
armGroups.description: Lazertinib (240 mg or 160 mg orally, once daily) plus Gefitinib-matching placebo (250 mg orally, once daily) in accordance with the randomization schedule

armGroups.label: Gefitinib + Lazertinib-matching placebo
armGroups.description: Gefitinib (250 mg orally, once daily) plus Lazertinib-matching placebo (240 mg or 160 mg orally, once daily) in accordance with the randomization schedule

interventions.name: Lazertinib 240 mg/160 mg
interventions.description: The initial dose of lazertinib 240 mg (3 tablets of 80 mg lazertinib) once daily can be reduced to 160 mg once daily (2 tablets of 80 mg lazertinib) under specific circumstances

interventions.name: Gefitinib 250 mg
interventions.description: The initial dose for Gefitinib (250 mg once daily) cannot be reduced to a lower dose

interventions.name: Lazertinib-matching placebo 240 mg/160 mg
interventions.description: The initial dose of lazertinib-matching placebo 240 mg (3 tablets of 80 mg lazertinib-matching placebo) once daily can be reduced to 160 mg once daily (2 tablets of 80 mg lazertinib-matching placebo) under specific circumstances

interventions.name: Gefitinib-matching placebo 250 mg
interventions.description: The initial dose for Gefitinib-matching placebo (250 mg once daily) cannot be reduced to a lower dose
